snippet.title: Project Motor Racing | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Why Drive … When you can RACE

Project Motor Racing ignites all the passion, beauty, and intensity of professional motorsport. Race across eras in 70+ iconic cars across 10 definitive racing classes in intense Single Player Career and Online Racing Modes.

Feel every second with a new, benchmark-setting physics engine built on the mod-friendly GIANTS Engine 10 that delivers unmatched handling realism and high-fidelity FFB. 

Experience “living” cockpits with visible G-forces, dirt, heat-haze, and then feel the precision of “True2Track” on 27 scanned track layouts, all with Dynamic Weather Conditions, Adaptive Racing & Drying Line, and a full 24-hour day/night cycle.

This is motor racing.

►Pre-Order Project Motor Racing now: https://projectmotorracing.com/buy-now.php

►Learn more on our website: https://projectmotorracing.com/

► And get more information on our Social Media channels
► BlueSky https://bsky.app/hashtag/projectmotorracing
► Discord https://discord.com/invite/pmr
► Facebook https://www.facebook.com/projectmotorracing/
► Forum https://hub.straight4.com/index.php
► Instagram https://www.instagram.com/ProjectMotorRacing
► TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@projectmracing
► Twitter https://x.com/ProjectMRacing  

Thank you to Derek Bell, Ben Collins, and our partners at Audi, Lamborghini, and Lola Cars, Lime Rock Park, Kyalami, and Canadian Tire Motorsport Park (Mosport)
